text:
Kevin: opened a small PR to tidy SDK snippets: add non-blocking python retry example, show TS generator + callback, and fix go formatting. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612
Mira: nice. can we also add a one-liner about cursor TTL in the migration notes? customers keep hitting short-lived cursors.
Kevin: good call, will add 2 lines and an example check for ExpiredCursor.
Tara: quick review: TS callback example needs types for `page.tokens`, and python should use `await retry_with_jitter(...)` not `time.sleep`.
Kevin: updated both. new python snippet:
```python
# async streaming + resumable cursor (non-blocking retry)
async for page in client.responses.stream_paginate(prompt):
    for tok in page.tokens:
        handle(tok)
    if page.had_transient_error:
        await retry_with_jitter(lambda: client.responses.resume(page.cursor))
```
Tara: LGTM. CI will probably flag gofmt on the Go sample.
ci-bot: docs-lint: link-check OK. gofmt: warning in examples/stream_resume.go (fixed in next push).
Kevin: pushed gofmt fix and added TTL note to migration guide. will backport to release/v1.8 as docs-only.
Mira: thanks. can you add a changelog line "docs: unify pagination examples across SDKs"? keeps integrators informed.
Kevin: added changelog entry and will post summary to #integrations after merge.
Tara: approved, minor wording nit removed.
ci-bot: all checks passed.
Kevin: merging now :rocket:
